The S&P Global UK Manufacturing PMI rose to 52.0 in September, up slightly from 51.7 in August and above the market expectation of 51.5, according to the preliminary estimate.

The S&P Global UK Composite PMI eased to 51.7 in September from 52.5 in the previous month, slightly under market expectations of 52, according to a flash estimate. Still, the result marked a third month of expansion in British private sector activity after the surge in prices from the war in Iran triggered back-to-back contractions in May.
The S&P Global UK Services PMI fell to 51.7 in September from 52.5 in August, below market forecasts of 52, flash estimates showed.

title: UK Composite PMI cools to 51.7 in September as manufacturing gains
